The Complete Modular Kitchen Guide

Layouts, materials, hardware and storage for a kitchen that handles real Indian cooking.

Home / Guides / The Complete Modular Kitchen Guide

By the Manzil Homes design team · Visakhapatnam

The kitchen is the hardest-working room in an Indian home. A good modular kitchen makes cooking easier, cleaning faster and storage smarter. Here's what to consider.

Choose the right layout

  • L-shaped: flexible and efficient for most apartments
  • U-shaped: maximum counter and storage space for larger kitchens
  • Parallel (galley): ideal for long, narrow kitchens
  • Straight: compact spaces and studio apartments
  • Island: open kitchens with enough floor space

Follow the work triangle

Keep the hob, sink and refrigerator within easy reach of each other, without anything blocking the paths between them.

Pick the right carcass material

Use moisture-resistant plywood, especially under the sink and in coastal cities like Vizag.

Choose finishes you can clean

Laminates are durable and practical, acrylic gives a high-gloss look, and lacquered glass is elegant on upper units. Matte finishes hide fingerprints better.

Invest in hardware

Soft-close hinges, tandem drawers, corner carousels and pull-outs make daily use easier and last longer than basic hardware.

Plan storage for Indian kitchens

  • Deep drawers for pressure cookers and heavy vessels
  • Tall units for groceries and bulk grains
  • Thali and cutlery organisers
  • A dedicated space for the mixer-grinder
  • Bottle pull-outs next to the hob

Ventilation and lighting

A chimney sized for Indian cooking plus under-cabinet task lighting make a big difference.

Vastu

The hob is traditionally placed in the south-east with the cook facing east, keeping the stove and sink apart.

Common mistakes

  • Too few electrical points
  • Placing the hob directly next to the refrigerator
  • Ignoring ventilation
  • Cheap hardware to save money

Frequently Asked Questions

Which kitchen layout is best for apartments?

L-shaped and parallel layouts suit most apartment kitchens. The best choice depends on the room's shape and door positions.

Which finish is easiest to maintain?

Good-quality laminates and matte finishes are the most practical for everyday Indian cooking.

Does Manzil Homes design modular kitchens?

Yes, as a standalone project or as part of full-home interiors.
